statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to optimize rate control management
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
SilverBridge Advantage requires all non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved
